scope: Actual Vulkan texture sharing, copy-on-write descriptor patches, mip sampling and scene reinstall. Analytical fixtures; original game image parity is not claimed.
checks: Shared large texture with original mip levels and independent transforms
Updating one instance preserves another instance using the shared texture
Reinstalling a scene reuses the unchanged cached image
Shared patch bytes update all requested instances
Patched shared descriptors preserve original cached texels for future maps
